#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 1000000007;

struct DisjointSetUnion {
    vector<ll> parent;

    DisjointSetUnion(ll n) {
        parent.resize(n);
        for (ll i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            parent[i] = i;
        }
    }

    ll find(ll a) {
        if (parent[a] == a) return a;
        parent[a] = find(parent[a]);
        return parent[a];
    }

    void unite(ll a, ll b) {
        a = find(a);
        b = find(b);
        if (a != b) {
            if (rand() % 2) swap(a, b);
            parent[b] = a;
        }
    }
};

ll compute_cycles(ll total, ll multiplier) {
    DisjointSetUnion dsu(total);
    for (ll i = 1; i < total; ++i) {
        ll target = (multiplier * i) % total;
        dsu.unite(i, target);
    }
    vector<bool> visited(total, false);
    ll cycle_count = 0;
    for (ll i = 1; i < total; ++i) {
        ll root = dsu.find(i);
        if (!visited[root]) {
            visited[root] = true;
            ++cycle_count;
        }
    }
    return cycle_count;
}

ll calculate_solutions(ll total, ll multiplier) {
    ll cycles;
    if (multiplier == 0) {
        cycles = total - 1;
    } else if (multiplier == 1) {
        cycles = total;
    } else {
        cycles = compute_cycles(total, multiplier);
    }
    ll result = 1;
    for (ll i = 0; i < cycles; ++i) {
        result = (result * total) % MOD;
    }
    return result;
}

    ll total, multiplier;
    cin >> total >> multiplier;
